headline: Save Mart expands Instacart curbside pickup across all NorCal banners
summary: Curbside is now live at Save Mart, Lucky and FoodMaxx stores — another sign grocers are leaning on third-party delivery infrastructure for perishables like cheese.

headline: CME cash cheese holds mostly steady as blocks edge down to $1.4225/lb
summary: Barrels flat at $1.4525/lb, blocks off a cent — a near-term signal for cost planning on block cheddar.

headline: Grocery unit sales slump in August as cyclospora scare hits produce
summary: Produce unit sales fell 6.7% after a cyclospora outbreak spooked shoppers — a reminder that food-safety scares can drag down adjacent perishable categories like cheese and deli.

headline: Global Dairy Trade index slips 1.1% as Cheddar prices jump 16.5%
summary: Cheddar led gains in the mid-September GDT auction while mozzarella and butter softened — worth watching for input costs on cheddar-heavy lines.

headline: Canada adds cheese to retaliatory tariffs on US goods
summary: Cross-border dairy trade fight escalates — a reason to flag exposure for any US-origin SKUs moving into Canadian accounts.

headline: Shareable snack-board engagement up 33% year over year
summary: One in five small-group dining menus now offers a customizable platter. Board culture is still compounding — the single most direct demand signal for a wedge-and-portion range.

headline: Texture becomes the purchase driver: crystalline bite, melt, the cheese pull
summary: Buyers are choosing on how a cheese performs, not just flavor. Aged, crystalline paste is a texture story — and it photographs, which is why the cut-wedge packshot matters.

headline: Retail cheese sales grow on convenience and flavor exploration
summary: Shoppers are trading into new varieties rather than trading down. Flavor discovery is doing the work price promotions used to — an opening for named-origin SKUs with a story.

headline: Global specialty cheese market projected to reach $40bn by 2031
summary: Roughly 5% annual growth, with premium imported varieties leading. Useful framing for a distributor conversation about where the category is heading.

headline: UK milk supply shifting toward cheese and yogurt as liquid milk demand falls
summary: More raw milk is being redirected into cheesemaking as fluid milk consumption keeps declining — a supply-side signal worth watching for import sourcing.
